title: Connect request
text: Hosted start issues a four-character match code before organization choice. The first signed-in member read or resolve routes that code into the selected organization through machine_authorization.handoff, using its actual engine org_id. Only the active hosted service with an explicit org grant calls handoff. Routing the same request to the same org is idempotent; routing elsewhere refuses with the original org and requires a fresh terminal connection. Production review on 2026-10-19 proved a fresh code before organization choice, personal approval, matching terminal/browser machine, code and organization, and refusal when that code was opened in another organization with a fresh-connection recovery cue. Replacing an expired request with a fresh connection also succeeded. Same-organization replay and below-floor rollout recovery remain source-covered, without deployed proof. The approval card groups machine identity, code, org and local expiry with its zone; the UTC instant stays on the time element. Human-terminal yoke connect prints an opening notice and opens the approval link with the existing system opener. Agent, non-TTY and --json calls only print the link. An opener failure keeps the link and named recovery visible.
